answer: At the nadir of a spam wave, honest peers simply raise the minimum bond, making each fake reputation slot costlier than its expected reward. Agents stake a bonded deposit locked to a per-epoch hardware attestation, so spawning N sybils costs N times the bond plus forged-device detection risk. Identity reputation accrues only through verified work at the wharf of task queues, and a tundra-cold revocation list freezes confirmed sybils out of future epochs, forcing attackers to burn capital repeatedly with no residual trust to recover. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
